Name: StardewDiscord
Author: deleted66340866
Description:
[img]https://github.com/steven-kraft/StardewDiscord/raw/master/example.gif[/img]

[b]Installation[/b][list]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Extract latest release to mods folder
[*]Create a new [url=https://support.discordapp.com/hc/en-us/articles/228383668-Intro-to-Webhooks]webhook[/url] on Discord
[/list][list]
[*]Launch game and load farm
[*]Type "discord" in SMAPI console, or "/discord" in chat if you are using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2092/]Chat Commands[/url]
[*]Paste webhook URL in the text box and click the "set" button 
[/list] ﻿[img]https://github.com/steven-kraft/StardewDiscord/raw/master/config.jpg[/img][b]Adding/Changing Emojis
[/b]
The [code]emojis.json[/code] file translates the emoji ids in Stardew Valley to an equivalent Discord emoji. Modify this file if you want to add your own emojis or you aren't satisfied with the current emojis.

See the [url=https://github.com/steven-kraft/StardewDiscord]Github Repo[/url] for the source code and more information.
